Alright, I've just finished sprinkling a bunch of CSS animations and transitions throughout the page: the hero text now rises in, the grid background drifts, the accent line draws itself, and the person cards have smooth hover effects. All those styles are defined, but they won’t actually do anything until the elements get the appropriate classes at the right time. I need a small JavaScript snippet that will:

1. Detect the user's reduced‑motion preference and gracefully disable animations if needed.
2. Tag the various sections, headings, mission statements, and other elements with the `.reveal` class so they can be animated on scroll.
3. For the people grid, add a staggered delay using a CSS custom property (`--d`) based on each card’s index.
4. Set up an IntersectionObserver to add the `.in` class when a `.reveal` element scrolls into view, falling back to instantly showing everything if IntersectionObserver isn’t supported or the user prefers reduced motion.
5. Finally, animate the hero stats numbers (the `.stat-num` elements) with a count‑up effect that starts after the hero rise animation completes, again respecting reduced‑motion.

<script>
(function () {
    var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    // Tag elements for scroll-reveal, staggering grids and groups.
    document.querySelectorAll('.section-label, .section h2, .section-sub, .mission blockquote, .accent-line, .mission > p, .mission-goal, .footer p').forEach(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('reveal');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.people-grid').forEach(function (grid) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(grid.children, function (card, i) {
            card.classList.add('reveal');
            card.style.setProperty('--d', (Math.min(i, 24) * 0.04) + 's');
        });
    });

    if (reduced || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('in'); });
    } else {
        var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
            entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('in');
                    io.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -5% 0px' });
        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
    }

    // Count up the hero stats once they animate in.
    if (!reduced) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.stat-num').forEach(function (el) {
            var text = el.textContent;
            var match = text.match(/\d+/);
            if (!match) return;
            var target = parseInt(match[0], 10);
            var start = null;
            var duration = 1100;
            function tick(ts) {
                if (start === null) start = ts;
                var p = Math.min((ts - start) / duration, 1);
                var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
                el.textContent = text.replace(match[0], String(Math.round(target * eased)));
                if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
                else el.textContent = text;
            }
            setTimeout(function () { requestAnimationFrame(tick); }, 480);
        });
    }
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
